scope: Source-anchored observations of tracked characters on dungeon floors. Rows establish presence at a reveal point, not continuous location between observations. Shared locationGroup values mean the characters are explicitly co-located at that observation; missing groups remain unknown.
coverageNotes: Floor seven begins in the Book 5 epilogue, which is outside the numbered-chapter corpus, so no character observations are published for that floor.

A dialogue mention or leaderboard appearance is not enough to establish physical co-location. Check-in observations establish the floor but leave locationGroup unset when the speaker's position is unknown.
Garret, Garret Two, Sir Rendlegore, and Rend are one canonical character. Alias changes are timed story events, not separate paths.
